page_cursor.description: Opaque position that reproduces this page in the same saved window, including position0.

scanned_through.description: Last candidate examined,0 at an empty start; at most watermark. It may belong to another attempt, so an empty page may still have continuation.

watermark.description: Fixed highest candidate sequence when this window began,0 if originally empty; not a count or an ETA.

action.description: Only revise accepts/requires a non-null spec. Enable requires current project approval permission.

ref.description: Empty allows all branches and tags; otherwise exact refs/heads/... or refs/tags/...; configured filters require a present matching event field.

reason.description: Well-formed UTF-8 without control characters. Literal data, not a nested display key.

localized.description: False means the original exact source is preserved rather than hidden by a generic translated validation message.

message_key.description: Stable catalog key; legacy.<code> with localized=false explicitly denotes an unmigrated exact diagnostic.

raw_data.description: Original UTF-8 data text, populated only on exact-attempt history pages; never translated or normalized. data remains a compatible parsed projection. The full serialized Event, including both representations, is bounded to2MiB by the reader. Other event reads omit this field.

result_source.description: List is metadata-only and returns not_loaded. Exact detail distinguishes a real runner receipt, manual reconciliation, child workflow and independently observed managed provider result; these are not interchangeable process evidence.

token.description: Returned once after a committed registration/rotation. Never stored in operation receipts; replay returns metadata only.

expected_sha256.description: Frozen from actual manifest in plan; must be absent/empty in environment configuration requests.

password.description: Existing account password proof; new account password. Server requires 12–1024 UTF-8 bytes, which is not a JSON Schema character count.

token.description: One-time secret in JSON body only; UI accepts manual input or URL fragment, never query/log/localStorage.

grants.description: Unique same-organization project grants; server validates project ownership.

token.description: First creation only. Never included in listing or replay; retain only in component memory until dismissed.

acknowledge_draft.description: Must be true for explicit adopt; not publication approval.

source_indices.description: Zero-based subset of the frozen source list. Never caller-supplied source snapshots or authority.

expected_version.description: Required JSON integer lexeme; missing/null/fractional/exponent forms are rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation identity; no control characters. Do not regenerate after an unconfirmed response.

locale.description: Empty string explicitly inherits defaults. Supported BCP47 aliases are canonicalized to zh-CN/en-US; the original submitted lexeme remains part of operation identity.

max_retries.description: Only explicitly transient failures of idempotent nodes may automatically retry; each retry creates a new attempt with durable backoff and a fixed total deadline.

timeout_seconds.description: Worker automatic-retry sequence total deadline; zero/omitted uses300 seconds for new kernel generation. Manual retry explicitly opens a new persisted window. Non-worker timeout semantics depend on node type. Bound prevents Go duration overflow.

role.description: Required except remove. owner requires owner-only transfer_owner action.

endpoint_origin.description: Fixed HTTPS origin or loopback HTTP origin, without path, query, fragment or credentials. Not model account health.

acceptance_percent.description: 100 * accepted_tasks / total_tasks; null when total_tasks is zero.

slot_id.description: Zero-based decimal slot, less than this registered runner's max_slots (server-enforced, maximum128).

role.description: Required except remove; cannot exceed caller authority.

sha256.description: Digest of the explicitly selected publication, not authority.

eligibility.description: Current eligibility of this exact published revision; historical receipt content is not overwritten.

expected_version.description: Creation requires0; update requires positive current CAS. Exact JSON integer lexeme required.

authorization_ticket.description: Short-lived opaque secret delivered only to current trusted assignment via this dedicated response. Never include in Assignment, Config, journal, browser storage or evidence.

tasks.description: Unique current accepted tasks actually delivered by the same run as both selected proofs; versions and real review basis are validated atomically.

active_generation.description: Last observed active pointer; not the CAS basis for another deployment.

generation.description: Highest reserved fencing generation. May exceed active_generation after failed/unknown attempts.

revision.description: Immutable content revision; v1 always 1 and content edits create a new plan.

state.description: completed means execution ended, not necessarily deployed or healthy; read ReleaseDeployment effect/health separately.

version.description: Mutable decision CAS version, independent of immutable revision and sha256.

token.description: Once-only plaintext credential; absent from registry and same-key replay. Memory only, no browser session/local storage.

profiles.description: Unique administrator-owned profile IDs and real configuration digests. At least one profile or deployment=true is required.

covers.description: 1-based criteria indexes of the exact stored requirement version. Publication requires unique valid coverage; incomplete drafts expose diagnostics.

failure_class.description: Only an explicitly known transient failure of an idempotent operation is eligible for bounded automatic retry; unknown outcomes require reconciliation.

message.description: Actual cumulative output tail. Server strips ANSI/control characters and redacts credential-shaped text; 1–8192 UTF-8 bytes.

estimated_hours.description: Required complete field. null is unknown; explicit 0 is known zero. Server accepts 0–100000 hours.

budget_limit.description: Cumulative admission units; null explicitly unlimited, zero prevents new worker attempts. Not tokens, monetary settlement or refundable capacity.
